subject: Co-hosted hackday + guest blog swap with NectarOps
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@nectarops.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Suri <priya.suri@nectarops.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: Co-hosted hackday + guest blog swap (Dec-Jan timeframe)

Hi Olga,

Hope you're well — we loved the demo you gave at SignalForge last month. NectarOps is planning a small partner-focused "Edge AI Hackday" for later December / early January and we'd like to explore co-hosting with Redwood. The concept: a half-day virtual hackday (3 hours) with 2 short partner talks, 3 hands-on breakout rooms, and a follow-up guest blog post summarizing notable projects. Our goals are developer-first lead gen and a lightweight content asset for both teams.

Quick details we have so far (attached one-sheet):
- Proposed dates: Dec 16, Dec 20, or Jan 7 (we can be flexible)
- Expected audience: 150–250 developers/infra engineers, target verticals: fintech, healthcare, marketplaces
- Sponsorship: NectarOps covers platform hosting + paid social; asking Redwood for a co-brand, one speaker, and a short guest blog by Jan 20
- Tracking: we can provide a registration link with UTM parameters and share attendee CSV post-event

Would love to set a 30 min sync next week to scope speakers, breakout topics, and any contract/PO needs. Attaching a one-sheet and a preliminary agenda.

Best,
Alex
Alex Kim
Head of Ecosystem Partnerships
NectarOps
alex.kim@nectarops.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Subject: Re: Proposal: Co-hosted hackday + guest blog swap (Dec-Jan timeframe)

Thanks Alex — this looks promising. Looping in Ben (Field Marketing) and Jasmine (Alliances) so we can scope from our side. A few quick asks from our end:

- Can you confirm whether NectarOps requires an MSA or if a simple partner event addendum suffices? We may need procurement lead time for any paid sponsorship.
- Audience profile: do you have a sample registrant list from prior events (roles + company size)? That helps us pick the right speaker and breakout topics.
- Speaker ask: Redwood can commit one senior engineer + 20–30 min demo slot; would prefer topics focused on inference cost optimizations and integrating Redwood caching.
- Promotion: which channels will NectarOps use? We can amplify via Redwood dev newsletter and social.

Ben / Jasmine — do we have bandwidth for Dec 16 or Dec 20? If not, propose Jan 7 as fallback. Also thinking we should ask for a modest sponsorship credit to cover ad spend and an event PR push.

Olga Petrov
Director, Alliances & Integrations
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com

All — good timing. Field marketing can support the event if we lock a date >2 weeks out (we need creative lead time). Quick notes:

- Availability: Dec 16 is tight for promo; Dec 20 could work but it's near holidays — Jan 7 is safest for registration velocity.
- Speaker: I recommend our SWE lead Marcus Lin for the demo (deep infra + quantization talk). If Marcus can't do it, I can present a practitioner's session focused on batching and KV cache strategies.
- Assets: we should get a joint registration page, co-branded slide deck template, and one joint blog draft (2–3 authors, 800–1,200 words).

Jasmine — can you lead speaker coordination and deck review? I'll own promo and registration. Karthik — please confirm whether we want an engineering or solutions speaker from our partner engineering team for the breakout rooms.

- Date confirmed: Jan 7, 2027 (virtual, 10:00–13:00 PT)
- Speakers: Marcus Lin (Redwood) for the platform demo; Alex Kim and Priya Suri (NectarOps) for partner intros
- Deliverables: joint registration page (we'll send embed), co-branded slides, a post-event guest blog draft due Jan 20, and a condensed $1,500 ad credit for Redwood to amplify the event on our side
- Contracting: we can accept a signed event addendum (NDA/terms not required). I'll attach an agenda draft and a one-sheet for internal approvals.

Action items for Redwood:
- Jasmine: confirm Marcus and breakout leads by Dec 17
- Ben: confirm HubSpot event record and promo calendar by Dec 20
- Olga: finalize the event addendum signature path (we can route via email acceptance)

We'll email the registration link to you as soon as the page is live. Looking forward to partnering on this — should be a nice dev-focused win for both teams.
